ceu: ✦ The trine between the Moon and Mercury at {H:1819032159000}

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.

The trine between the Moon and Mercury brings together, in your favour, money and routine: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mercury brings ideas and words. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Make a list of what you have already achieved and give thanks.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.

The trine between the Moon and Mercury brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mercury brings ideas and words. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Look at yourself in the mirror with the tenderness you show the people you love.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.

The trine between the Moon and Mercury brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mercury brings ideas and words. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Sleep a little longer, if you can.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.

The trine between the Moon and Mercury brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mercury brings ideas and words. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Do a friend a favour without expecting anything in return.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.

The trine between the Moon and Mercury brings together, in your favour, your career and money: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mercury brings ideas and words. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Say no to a task that is not yours.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.

The trine between the Moon and Mercury brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mercury brings ideas and words. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Accept an invitation that is different from usual.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.

The trine between the Moon and Mercury brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mercury brings ideas and words. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Speak frankly about a matter you keep avoiding.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.

The trine between the Moon and Mercury brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mercury brings ideas and words. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Give way on something small to gain on something big.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.

The trine between the Moon and Mercury brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mercury brings ideas and words. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Book that test or check-up you keep putting off.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.

The trine between the Moon and Mercury brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mercury brings ideas and words. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Allow yourself a sweet or a treat without guilt.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.

The trine between the Moon and Mercury brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mercury brings ideas and words. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Tidy a drawer or a corner of the house that bothers you.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.

The trine between the Moon and Mercury brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mercury brings ideas and words. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Take a different route on your usual way.
